name: cable high row with chest support
description: A two-handed cable row from a high pulley with your chest braced on a pad. It trains the upper back and rear shoulders.
instructions: Set the cable high and lean your chest against the support pad.
Grab the handles and extend your arms.
Pull your elbows back and slightly down.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Let your arms extend slowly to the start.
